# Bludle

> Bludle is an independent collection of free browser puzzle games created by Stuart Pecksen. Games cover words, colour perception, logic, visual and musical memory, and reaction speed. No download is required.

- Canonical site: https://bludle.com/
- Creator and contact: https://bludle.com/about/
- Editorial policy: https://bludle.com/editorial-policy/
- Journal: https://bludle.com/blogs/
- Sitemap: https://bludle.com/sitemap.xml
- Last updated: 2026-08-19

## Games

### Word games

- [Werdle](https://bludle.com/werdle/): Play Werdle free: solve a five-letter daily word in five tries, reveal its origin, or switch to unlimited practice with no sign-up. Format: Daily puzzle and unlimited practice. Typical round: About 3–5 minutes.
- [Bludle](https://bludle.com/bludle/): Play Bludle free and decode a five-letter word from shades of blue, with A at the light end and Z at the darkest end of the alphabet spectrum. Format: Daily visual word puzzle. Typical round: About 2–4 minutes.
- [Codle](https://bludle.com/codle/): Play Codle free and decode five-letter word ciphers built from shifting, mirroring, reversing and alternating alphabet rules. Format: Progressive code-breaking rounds. Typical round: About 3–6 minutes.
- [Connex](https://bludle.com/connex/): Sort sixteen words into four hidden groups by finding the connection shared by each set. Format: Browser word-association puzzle. Typical round: About 5–10 minutes.
- [Word Mash](https://bludle.com/wordmash/): Build a chain of overlapping words by finding the shared letters that join one answer to the next. Format: Daily overlap puzzle. Typical round: About 3–5 minutes.
- [Glyph](https://bludle.com/glyph/): Identify daily words from their typographic silhouettes before the individual letters are revealed. Format: Five daily silhouette puzzles. Typical round: About 3–6 minutes.
- [Borrowed Letters](https://bludle.com/borrowedletters/): Repair five clue answers whose misplaced letters have been passed around a circular chain. Format: Daily circular word puzzle. Typical round: About 5–8 minutes.

### Colour games

- [Shifty Fades](https://bludle.com/shiftyfades/): Find the exact target colour among near matches across fifty increasingly subtle levels. Format: Fifty progressive levels. Typical round: About 2–8 minutes.
- [Colour Match](https://bludle.com/colormatch/): Recreate the daily target colour by adjusting its red, green and blue channels, then compare both RGB values. Format: One daily target and one submission. Typical round: About 2–4 minutes.
- [Afterimage](https://bludle.com/afterimage/): Memorise a colour, wait for it to disappear, and rebuild it from RGB controls across five daily rounds. Format: Five daily memory rounds. Typical round: About 4–7 minutes.
- [Chroma Lock](https://bludle.com/chromalock/): Stop a cycling colour at the instant it matches the target in a compact visual timing puzzle. Format: Progressive timing challenge. Typical round: About 2–5 minutes.
- [Guess Hue](https://bludle.com/guesshue/): Play Guess Hue free: spot the one different colour in four seconds as each successful round makes the hue difference more subtle. Format: Endless four-second rounds. Typical round: Usually 1–5 minutes.
- [Tintuition](https://bludle.com/tintuition/): Match colours by eye using HSL controls, build combos and climb through increasingly exact ranks. Format: Ranked colour-matching run. Typical round: About 3–8 minutes.

### Logic games

- [XY Marks the Spot](https://bludle.com/hunt/): Use coordinate, direction and distance clues to locate hidden treasure before your limited scans run out. Format: Guided demo then puzzle rounds. Typical round: About 3–6 minutes.
- [Seequence](https://bludle.com/seequence/): Memorise a colour sequence, then reproduce the exact pattern after it disappears. Format: Progressive memory streak. Typical round: About 2–6 minutes.
- [Dead Centre](https://bludle.com/deadcentre/): Memorise a target, wait for it to vanish, and click its exact centre across eight daily spatial-memory rounds. Format: Eight daily spatial rounds. Typical round: About 3–5 minutes.

### Speed games

- [Reaction](https://bludle.com/reaction/): Measure how quickly you respond to a visual change through short, repeatable browser reaction tests. Format: Repeatable reaction trials. Typical round: Under 2 minutes.
- [Alternate](https://bludle.com/alternate/): React to each colour switch and stretch a five-second time budget through a fast sequence of accurate responses. Format: Five-second reaction run. Typical round: Under 1 minute.
- [Trak](https://bludle.com/trak/): Follow a moving signal after it disappears and stop it inside changing targets on lines, curves, circles and shaped tracks. Format: Progressive visual tracking levels. Typical round: About 2–6 minutes.

### Audio games

- [Heardle](https://bludle.com/heardle/): Listen to a sequence of musical notes, then recreate the melody from memory before your lives run out. Format: Melody memory game. Typical round: About 2–5 minutes.
